import pathlib,json,os,hmac,hashlib,struct
import cryptography
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import ec
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.serialization import Encoding,PublicFormat
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.aead import AESGCM
from cryptography.exceptions import InvalidTag
out=pathlib.Path(os.environ['OUT'])
constants=json.loads(pathlib.Path('store/jobs/j000318/out/storage-key-constants.json').read_text())['hits']
assert len(constants)==2 and constants[0]['resolved']==constants[1]['resolved']
resolved=constants[0]['resolved'];path=resolved['DETERMINISTIC_KEY_PATH']
seed=pathlib.Path('store/jobs/j000319/out/serialized-seed-4.bin').read_bytes();assert len(seed)==80
I=hmac.new(b'Bitcoin seed',seed[:64],hashlib.sha512).digest();k=int.from_bytes(I[:32],'big');chain=I[32:];order=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEBAAEDCE6AF48A03BBFD25E8CD0364141
assert 0<k<order
for part in path.split('/')[1:]:
 hardened=part.endswith("'");index=int(part.rstrip("'"))+(0x80000000 if hardened else 0)
 key=k.to_bytes(32,'big')
 if hardened:data=b'\0'+key
 else:data=ec.derive_private_key(k,ec.SECP256K1()).public_key().public_bytes(Encoding.X962,PublicFormat.CompressedPoint)
 I=hmac.new(chain,data+struct.pack('>I',index),hashlib.sha512).digest();left=int.from_bytes(I[:32],'big');assert left<order
 k=(left+k)%order;assert k;chain=I[32:]
s=pathlib.Path('store/jobs/j000200/out/storage.seco').read_bytes();length=struct.unpack('>I',s[512:516])[0]
assert len(s)==516+length and hashlib.sha256(s[256:516]+s[516:]).digest()==s[224:256]
N,r,p=struct.unpack('>III',s[288:300]);wrapping=hashlib.scrypt(k.to_bytes(32,'big'),salt=s[256:288],n=N,r=r,p=p,dklen=32,maxmem=128*1024*1024)
summary={'method':'Offline single source-defined BIP32 private-key path, first64 serialized seed bytes; scrypt and authenticated SECO key/blob envelopes. No recovered code execution or key guesses.','path':path,'seed_serialized_bytes':len(seed),'scrypt':{'N':N,'r':r,'p':p},'cryptography_version':cryptography.__version__,'checksum_valid':True,'key_envelope_authenticated':False,'payload_authenticated':False}
try:
 blobkey=AESGCM(wrapping).decrypt(s[332:344],s[360:392]+s[344:360],None);summary['key_envelope_authenticated']=True
 plain=AESGCM(blobkey).decrypt(s[392:404],s[516:]+s[404:420],None);summary['payload_authenticated']=True;summary['payload_bytes']=len(plain)
 (out/'storage-authenticated-payload.bin').write_bytes(plain)
except InvalidTag:summary['result']='Authentication failed for this one source-defined derivation/envelope interpretation; no storage-content absence inferred.'
(out/'storage-authentication-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2));print(json.dumps(summary))
